newsitem.title: USA: BET Holdings chairman cuts stake.
newsitem.headline: BET Holdings chairman cuts stake.

text.p: Robert Johnson, chairman and chief executive of BET Holdings Inc, said on Thursday he had cut his stake in the company to the equivalent of 7,145,710 class A shares, or 47 percent of the class outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Johnson said he sold 100,765 class A shares between June 14 and August 8 at prices ranging from $23.50 to $28 a share.
Johnson also said that on August 26, he transferred 842,105 shares to FW Strategic Partners L.P. in exchange for limited partnership interests in the firm.

According to the filing, Johnson holds 2,165,310 class A shares and 4,820,000 class C shares. The class C shares are entitled to 10 votes each and are convertible to class A stock on a share-for-share basis.
In addition, he holds stock option agreements to buy 80,800 class A shares. His wife holds options to buy 79,500 class A shares and holds 100 class A shares, the filing showed.
